Right at the end of the other tape I think you wanted to talk about Joya, right?

We were speaking of the different voices and the different types of voices, and Joya was a very nice little vocalist, but she lent her talents mostly to the -- I wouldn't say comedy line, but the show line. She was more of a show voice, and she made a couple of real nice records and did a lot of nice work in shows. In fact, I think she tried out for a couple of shows and was accepted. But when -- broke up from Van -- I never see very many of these people any more, because we're too -- stretched too far apart.
New England? Or is it out on the Island in New York?
Her husband is the contractor, building contractor.
I spoke to Kay Davis and I thought she told me -- I guess -- it's Maria Ellington Cole [Devore] that's living in New England now.
Yes, I think she lives up there somewhere.
I guess Joya is on the Island, and they get in touch with each other from time to time.
Yes, uh-huh, they were all very friendly.
